Welcome! Please replace the prompts below with your own answers and click
**Submit new issue**. Nothing here is graded and nothing is private to the
course staff — everyone enrolled can read it, which is the point.

**Name and how you'd like to be addressed**
<!-- e.g. "Jane Doe, please call me Jane" -->

**Lab / PI, and what you work on**
<!-- One or two sentences. Organism, disease area, technique — whatever locates you. -->

**What do you want to be able to do by Session 10?**
<!-- Be concrete if you can: "analyze my own knockout RNA-seq without asking
     the core", "understand what my collaborator's DESeq2 output means",
     "run the pipeline on a public GEO dataset". -->

**Do you already have RNA-seq data of your own?**
<!-- Yes / No / It's being sequenced now. Sessions 9 and 10 are "bring your
     own data" — knowing this early helps us plan. If yes, roughly how many
     samples and what's the comparison? -->

**Prior programming experience**
<!-- None at all is a completely normal answer and several of you are in that
     category — say so honestly so we pitch the hands-on sessions correctly.
     Otherwise: R? Python? bash? Used a cluster before? -->

**Anything else**
<!-- Optional. Sessions you already know you'll miss, accessibility needs,
     something you're nervous about, or nothing at all. -->
